fact: The Directorate General for territorial administration says the civil registration, legal identity and health systems are to be interconnected, and civil registration is to be integrated with the national digital identity system.
Burundi's presentation says the civil registration system is 'not yet fully interoperable' with the future national digital identification system.

We Are Tech Africa reports the Ministry of the Interior presented on 6 May 2026 one digital platform for managing civil registration and producing the new biometric national ID card, with civil records being digitised.
system: digital platform for civil registration management and biometric national identity card
